content: Inoke bahi tage panpankiti houwan hot toto Keliso kaiwena ya awawana ta panpankiti-an papasikali. Iyaka hi pankitela gegi paganina toto ana abapwamowasi yaomal ana en ta pek ge ta abulilek Yehoba elana. Ge iyaka hi pankitela babitaiso kaiwena ge ekelesiya ana tohouwa nimaliya nihi teli kokowalaa inoke Yayaluwa Bwabwalena ni tuwalaliya elala. Ge iyaka hi pankitela Yehoba toyaomal ni palutil ge gamagalau gegewel ni pakotil inoke molaliya mihomihotina ni pek. He bahi wauwau bolo o ta mimi sepasepa-an, yaa ta noewa maninilaa panpankiti toto ni pamatuwa-agila ta ahe.
Ge ebo Yehoba wana nuwatu i ola, nasi ta ginol ola ge panpankiti toto ni pamatuwa-agimiu naha pankitemiu ge nuku atena.

Ta noewa maninilaa, bahi nuku sisikalek emiwa. He ebo gamagalau Keliso wasana mwananalina i yanel ga, ge Yehoba wana mulolu eliyalil amnana hi anbose ga, avaliyau toabulilek gegewel Yayaluwa Bwabwalena hi ahe ga,
Yehoba wana baaba eliyalil ana waisi amnana hi anbose ga, ge gasisi toto Yehoba abwe ni patuwalali sauga mulaa elana hi ahe ga,

ge ebo abwe Keliso nihi towani ana en nihi pek, he nige bosowaina ge ta ahel pasikalil wali gegi o ana en nihi pek. Kaiwena i ola te Yehoba Natuna hi lolokolos-an al, ge hi papapuluwawi-an boda mataliyaa.
Gamagalau enuna hi ola bilibili toto sauga gegewena kehe i vinum ge enona i gan bolo hi eyowaan kaiweliya, inoke ta awa wawaisi-an. He gamagalau o Yehoba ni muloluagil.

Yaa gamagalau enuna hi ola bilibili toto enona iyai te pepesala ge mwawin nanakil, inoke ta ba, “Bilibili nanakina” ge ta ton yoho. He gamagalau o Yehoba abwe ni nuwamutagil, wali abapwamowasi ginaha elana.

Wama heliyamwau nunuwanil, bwagana baaba amnana gaganina ololana o ha baunan eliyamiu, yaa atema i matuwaagimiu. Ha atena bubun te komiu ku ginol bubun ya, pagan toto gamagalau bolo Yehoba i pwamwalil bosowailiya heiya te ku giginol.

Wami tuwalali i waisi ge wami nunuwana Yehoba elana ku pamasal, kaiwena wana gamagalau ku label ge komiu iyoho ku lalalabel. He Yehoba iya tosapu, inoke wami tuwalali o ge wami nunuwana o nige ni nunuluwan, abwe molamiu waiwaisana ni pewa.

Inoke nuwama hot te komiu maisena ge maisena tuwalali toto o nuku ginol pagasisi ana siga yawalimiu ana abapwamowasi, yaka wami atimatuwa ni gasisi ge nuku matamatan waisi toto Yehoba i bateli kaiwela.
Nige nuwama nuku pweyata, yaa wami pagan ni ola bolo hi abulilek ge hi palahikan inoke eliyana Yehoba wana bateli kaiweliya hi ahe.
Sauga Yehoba wana bateli i baunan Abalahama eliyana, he nige gamagal etegana iya alana i bwabwata lake ge tage alana ni papasila-an, inoke i ba, “Totou alau ya papasila-an te
tunahot na muloluagiwa ge tubutubunim nihi gewi.”
Yaka Abalahama i palahikan ge i matamatan inoke Yehoba wana bateli enowana i ahe.
Ebo kila gamagalau nuwala ta papasila, he gamagal bwabwatana etegana alana ta papasila-an, inoke papasila o i patunahot te hauna ta baunan i tunahot, yaka awabalgig i pwamowasi.
He Yehoba nuwana wana bateli ni patunahot, inoke wana bateli i papasila-an. Nuwana ta atena bubun te wana nuwatu nige ni pipil getogaan, kila wana bateli Abalahama elana enowana ana toahe.

Inoke wana bateli ge wana papasila hi mina, bugul labui o mihomihotil nige bosowaina pilina ni gan ge nige bosowaina Yehoba ni kakawi kaiweliya. Inoke kilau bolo iyaka ta lou tuk Yehoba labenaa, bosowaina bugul labui o ta nuwatuagil ge gasisi ta ahe alola wala atimatuwa ta matamatan waisi kaiwena toto iyoho maninilaa.

Waisi o ana atimatuwa i ola yawalila ana anka, inoke i kukuhikagila ta mibubun ge nige nak ni bibinila. He wala anka o ana abakukuhikan heiya Yehoba totona, iya i minaa labulabumwa Aban Bwabwalena Hot elana kaliko toto limi tapwalolo hi baba tomwaya enaa.
Yeisu i houwa maninilaa i tuk Aban Bwabwalena Hot gamwanaa kila kaiwela, kaiwena i tabwa topowon bwabwatana i ola topowon Melkisedek ge ni topowon sauga gegewena nige ni momowasi.

footnotes.text: Aban Bwabwalena Hot bana Hibilu 9:1-5 nu kite. Yehoba i minaa Aban Bwabwalena Hot elana ge i masamasala Mosese elana (Totagil 25:17-22). He toto ya Yehoba wana abamina labulabumwa ana ba kakanun te.
